description: Edits an image you provide instead of generating one from scratch: pass the image and a black-and-white mask, and Stable Diffusion inpainting repaints only the white area following your prompt. Image and mask go as https URLs or as base64, up to 10 MB each. Returns a hosted image URL valid for 24 hours. You are only charged if the edit is delivered. No API key, no account. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

guidance.description: How closely to follow the prompt, 0-20.

image.description: The image to edit, as base64. Use this or url.

mask.description: The mask, as base64. Use this or mask_url.

mask_url.description: https URL of the mask: white where it should repaint, black where it must not. Use this or mask.

prompt.description: What to paint into the masked area, up to 2048 characters.

seed.description: Same inputs and same seed give the same edit.

url.description: https URL of the image to edit. Use this or image.

name: ai_image_edit
title: Edit an image you already have (inpainting)
